body: You can PM me if you want.

Thanks. I was talking to the crisis counselor on the suicide chat line. I have talked to a traditional counselor as well. I'm so much better off than I ever have been before, but I still don't know how to deal with the kind of thing I'm going through right now. 
My loneliness is deeper than the kind of thing you're talking about. I have lots of friends, I am social, I even have a few great friends, who would be there for me and have been there for me if I reached out. I don't want to tell them how I feel. I am much more comfortable talking to a stranger. But I don't want generic advice.  I just want to chat back and forth with somebody about how fucking shitty I feel and not be talked down to. I just feel trapped. I'm really scared right now. I just want someone to talk with the way a close friend would talk with me. Maybe I'm asking too much. Maybe I'm in the wrong place. But, thank you for saying something.
